name: Native memory and durable execution
description: Rust-owned explicit facts and execution journal with a contained offline embedding helper.
runtime: Rust owns state on the host. Embedding alone runs in Linux ARM64 rootless OCI with no network, credentials or project-data mount.
memory: Explicit versioned facts; SQLite FTS5 and exact multilingual dense retrieval over eligible records.
workflow: Rust transition journal, bounded snapshot/delta replay and conservative effect recovery.
